content: TU Delft MSc thesis van Wolfswinkel (2026-10-01, repository.tudelft.nl uuid:eb09dbf7): synthetic LLM queries reuse source wording => lexically easier; higher source-overlap lowers sparse-retrieval ranking agreement; Kendall tau 0.48-0.88 with source-only labels, 0.69-1.00 after pooled LLM relabeling; NFCorpus synthetic nDCG@10 0.92 vs 0.32 real. Mitigations: paraphrase prompting (localGPT paraphrases.jsonl content-word overlap ~0.21), report BM25-only vs hybrid deltas separately, never move defaults on synthetic-only wins. SIF existing fixture already encodes exact-run CJK and unique codenames.
